basics.description: Step 2 of the Segue custom-domain flow. Binds a domain (hostname + free Azure-managed SSL certificate) to the Segue app from an already-deployed Segue stack. The domain field below is optional - leave it blank to skip this app entirely this run. If Step 1 did NOT enable Web Application Firewall: this is ONE deploy that registers the hostname, creates the certificate, and binds it together - but create the CNAME + asuid TXT records shown below at your DNS provider and wait for them to propagate BEFORE deploying (InvalidCustomHostNameValidation otherwise). If Step 1 DID enable it: the domain binds to Front Door instead, and its DNS validation token only appears in this deployment's Outputs AFTER you deploy - see the info box below once you select that option.

basics.name: namePrefix
basics.label: Deployment name prefix
basics.toolTip: The same prefix used for the original Segue deployment (e.g. 'segue12') - builds <prefix>-app, <prefix>-env.

constraints.validationMessage: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, starting with a letter - the same prefix your Segue deployment used.

elements.name: usesFrontDoorWaf
elements.label: Web Application Firewall in Step 1?
elements.toolTip: Must match whatever you chose for Web Application Firewall when you first deployed Segue (Step 1) — this wizard has no way to detect that on its own. Yes routes this domain through Front Door + the WAF instead of binding it directly to the app; the DNS/validation flow below is different for each.

allowedValues.label: No — Step 1 did not enable it (default)
Yes — Step 1 enabled Front Door WAF

elements.name: domain
elements.label: Custom domain (optional)
elements.toolTip: e.g. app.example.com. Leave blank to skip this app entirely this run.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave blank to skip, or enter a valid domain name (e.g. app.example.com).

options.text:
[concat('Create these records at your DNS provider:', '
', '  CNAME   ', steps('fhirbridgeAppStep').domain, '   ->   ', first(split(last(split(string(steps('fhirbridgeAppStep').appDetailsApi), '"fqdn":"')), '"')), '
', '  TXT     asuid.', steps('fhirbridgeAppStep').domain, '   ->   ', first(split(last(split(string(steps('fhirbridgeAppStep').appDetailsApi), '"customDomainVerificationId":"')), '"')), '

', 'Create these records and wait for them to propagate BEFORE deploying - this one deploy registers the hostname, creates the certificate, and binds it, all together. Deploying before DNS is ready fails cleanly (InvalidCustomHostNameValidation) - just wait and redeploy once it resolves.')]

Front Door's validation token is different from the Container App's, and only exists once the domain is actually created — it cannot be shown here before you deploy. After this deployment finishes, open its Outputs tab and copy frontDoorCustomDomainValidationToken, then create a TXT record at _dnsauth.<your domain> with that value. Azure detects it and issues the certificate automatically in the background — no second deploy needed for this path.
